players.bio: Andrea De Zordo is an Italian Formula One engineer. He is currently the technical director at the Haas Formula One team. Career Born in Faenza, Italy - the same town renowned for its longstanding association with Italian motorsport - De Zordo developed an early passion for racing and engineering.

Esteban José Jean-Pierre Ocon-Khelfane (French pronunciation: ; born 17 September 1996) is a French racing driver, who is contracted to compete in Formula One for Haas. He made his Formula One debut for Manor Racing in the 2016 Belgian Grand Prix, replacing Rio Haryanto. Ocon is part of the Mercedes-Benz driver development programme.

Oliver James Bearman (born 8 May 2005) is a British racing driver, who is contracted to compete in Formula One for Haas. He is currently the reserve driver for Scuderia Ferrari and Haas F1 Team in Formula One, the former of whom he will make his Formula One debut for at the 2024 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix substituting for Carlos Sainz Jr.

Rafael Chaves Câmara (born 5 May 2005) is a Brazilian racing driver, who is set to compete in the 2026 FIA Formula 2 Championship for Invicta Racing. Câmara is the 2024 Formula Regional European champion and the 2022 Formula 4 UAE runner-up, driving in both for Prema Racing. He is a member of the Ferrari Driver Academy.

Ryo Hirakawa (Japanese: 平川 亮, Hepburn: Hirakawa Ryō; born 7 March 1994) is a Japanese racing driver who is currently competing for Toyota Gazoo Racing in the FIA World Endurance Championship. He was Super GT GT500 champion in 2017, and finished runner-up in Super Formula in 2020.
